leadText: Townes, Hoyt, and Miles (Japanese: レモンキッズ Lemon Kids) are minor characters who appeared in The Power of Us. The three of them run a lemonade stand in Fula City.
plainText:
Townes, Hoyt, and Miles (Japanese: レモンキッズ Lemon Kids) are minor characters who appeared in The Power of Us. The three of them run a lemonade stand in Fula City.

==History==
Townes, Hoyt, and Miles were first seen running a lemonade stand in Fula City. While moving their operation, Margo bumped into them and they lost several of their lemons. Annoyed, they threw a lemon at her, only for to catch it. They sent out to battle , only for it to be quickly defeated. Ash asked if they were interested in a second round, but the three boys left in a hurry.

Townes, Hoyt, and Miles were later seen helping the other civilians clean up the city. They informed Risa and the others about 's curse, but Margo dismissed their tale as fake.

==Character==
Townes, Hoyt, and Miles are a boisterous group of boys that often hang out together. The trio enjoys a good laugh and they often discuss the strange rumors surrounding Fula City.
